title: Agent loop contract
description: Declares how an agent verifies its own work in this repository. The loop runner is generic; this file is the only per-project part.

gates.description: Verification tiers ordered by latency budget.

fast.description: Under ~15s. Safe to run after every edit.

test.description: Under ~2min. Run after completing a unit of work.

full.description: Unbounded. Must pass before declaring work done or opening a PR.

services.description: Long-running processes this project needs. Used by `loop doctor`.

health.description: HTTP URL polled to decide if the service is up.

port.description: Port to check for a listener when no health URL exists.

maxIterations.description: How many fix-and-rerun cycles an agent may burn on one gate before escalating to a human.

gateTimeoutSec.description: Per-check timeout. The check is killed and marked failed when exceeded.

stopGate.description: Tier the Claude Code Stop hook requires green before the agent may finish. null disables the gate.

postEditGate.description: Run the fast tier automatically after every file edit. High friction; opt in per repo.

retro.description: Whether `loop retro` may write learned rules into this repo and commit them unattended. Off unless explicitly set to "auto" — this writes to shared code, so it must be chosen per repo rather than inherited. Do not enable on a repo you share with other people without their agreement.

name.description: Stable identifier. Used as the history fingerprint key, so renaming it resets that check's learned history.

cmd.description: Shell command. Non-zero exit means failure.

cwd.description: Directory relative to the repo root. Defaults to the repo root.

optional.description: Runs and is reported, but never fails the gate. For slow or flaky checks.
